verdict.rationale: Opting out of usage tracking or analytics is a fair privacy question for a SaaS payroll and finance platform like Gusto, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a user-facing telemetry or tracking opt-out. The pack covers only business formation, banking and cash-flow features. The robots.txt Content-Signal marker governs AI crawling of Gusto's website, which is an adjacent control and not user telemetry opt-out.
